summary: Track surface material loader invoked from SpecialFX_Init. Parses a surface material definition from config entries (legal flag, base friction plus wet modifier, resistance, bump amplitude/wavelength, spring, damper, collision friction, sparks/scraping sound flags, sink depth, tire surface sound IDs) into a material struct, and resolves a material-name string into the same buffer.

local_names.a2: config source handle passed to the sub_4CDC70 token parsers
local_names.a3: config context passed through to the sub_4CDC70 token parsers
local_names.SrcStr: temporary CHAR buffer reused for property and material strings
local_names.v13: temporary float/double value reused for wet, bumpwavelen and sink lookups
local_names.v14: temporary int scratch for the scraping flag lookup

operations.description: Read the 'Legal' property via sub_565520 into SrcStr; when present and sub_588410 reports it is not equal to 'true', set the byte at this+0x60 to 1.
Parse the token at off_5D38EC into the float at this+8 (base friction) via sub_4CDC70; on success copy it into the float at this+12.
Parse the 'Wet' token into v13; on success recompute this+12 as (base friction at this+8) minus v13 (wet modifier).
Parse the 'Resistance' token into the float at this+16 (result discarded).
Parse the 'Bumpamp' token into the float at this+20; on success scale it by 0.25 (bump amplitude).
Parse the 'Bumpwavelen' token into v13; on success clamp v13 to a minimum of 3.0 and store 6.283185307179586 / v13 (bump wave frequency) at this+24.
Parse the 'Spring' token into the float at this+28 (result discarded).
Parse the 'Damper' token into the float at this+32 (result discarded).
Parse the 'Collfrict' token into the float at this+36 (result discarded).
Resolve the 'Sparks' token via sub_565760 into the string at this+40.
Resolve the 'Scraping' token via sub_565760 into v14; on success set the byte at this+44 to (v14 != 0).
Parse the 'Sink' token into v13; on success store it as a double at this+100 (sink depth).

Read the 'Sound' property via sub_565520 into SrcStr; then strcmp against off_5D38EC (default), 'Wet', 'Dirt', 'Grass', 'Gravel', 'Rumble', 'Tirewall', and 'Solidwall'/'Guardrail' to select a triple of tire surface sound IDs written to this+48/+52/+56 (default 6,21,27; wet 7,22,27; dirt 9,24,32; grass 8,23,32; gravel 10,25,32; rumble 11,21,27; tirewall 32,32,32; solidwall/guardrail 27,27,27). A non-matching string leaves the existing values untouched.
Look up the 'Materials' token via sub_5654A0 into SrcStr; the non-zero result gates the material-string normalization below.

When SrcStr is non-empty, normalize it: shift the buffer left over each space character and over each comma not followed by another comma or the terminator, until the terminator is reached, then call sub_589901 on the buffer.
Return StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(&SrcStr) when the 'Materials' lookup succeeded, copying the normalized material-name string into a reallocated buffer.
Return the copied material string on the success path, or the (non-zero) lookup result otherwise.
